PESTS AND DISEASES (PA): rat baiting one round on 1,308.31 ha with STORM (2 baits/palm Main, 1 in Sg Kaindangan), programme complete; STORM dearer than budgeted Ebor so cost RM45/ha vs 35. No bagworm treatment; some signs seen. No Oryctes treatment, no serious damage. Odd Ganoderma palm in 2004/2005 fields; no census. Rat census every 3 months; bait above 10%. Agro: localised rat damage in Tobe and 19A, formal census recommended; RB-damaged palms in 24A/25A not fully recovered.

PRUNING (PA Table 13): 749,037 palms vs 650,264 programme (115%, 4.6 rounds), excess from corrective pruning in Sg Kaindangan, now complete. Fronds to be stacked in patches within 4 palms. Agro (Table 8, to May 2026): Main Division 87-99%; Tobe (Table 11) 08A 69%, 10A 70%, 10B 93%, 16A 71%, short of harvesters; frond snapping on steep hills; FY26/27 cycle started.

ROADS AND DRAINS (PA): grading 873 of 5,927 chains (15%) at RM1.45/m (RM29.18/chain), to finish by June 2026; gravelling 385 chains (92%); 12,416 t crusher run/red stone at RM52.69/t; backhoe 1,001 hours at RM48/hr, excavator 1,962 hours at RM80/hr. Roads RM873/ha vs 759. Drain desilting 4x3x2 ft 3,478 m, 6x4x3 ft 1,608 m, plus 320 m and 590 m in larger sizes; drains RM76/ha vs 20. EFB in Sg Kaindangan (soil conservation RM13/ha); palm base mounding in 2019A1. Boundaries RM1/ha; no FFB theft but security must tighten.

HARVESTING (PA): manual cut and carry with wheelbarrows; mini crawler damaged; farm tractor with grabber loads to bins; external transport outsourced at RM24, 26 and 27/t; internal transport by estate tractors, outsourcing pending contractor consent. Feb 2026 intervals mostly 10-16 days, blocks 48-49 16-21 days; blocks 64, 67, 68, 90 only 1 round. Harvester rates RM41-61/t, output 0.44-4.09 t/man-day. Harvest and collection (Table 18) RM122.59/t vs 105.57: supervision 5.38, harvesting 65.43, loose fruit 0.05, infield loading 7.77 (unbudgeted), ramp 0.25, internal transport 20.34 vs 15.00, tools 1.56, despatch/selling 21.81 vs 20.63; excluding external transport RM100.78 vs 84.95.
Agronomy: Main Division intervals within standard (19A 9-14 days all year; 08A over standard 21-24 days Apr 2026). Tobe intervals worsened from Dec 2025; Apr-May 2026 10B up to 31 days, most Tobe up to 20 days in May. Harvesting rounds May 2026: 04A, 06A, 09A, 19A 3; 05C 2.8; 05D 2.7; 10B 2.5; 05B 2.3; 05A 2; 08A and 10A 1.7 (85%); 16A 1 (50%). Crop quality good; some oxidised loose fruit at platforms.

PALM CONDITION (Agro): no major deficiencies; blocks 52, 65, 68, 67, 54, 80 improving. Etiolation in ravines; no thinning where replanting within 5 years. Tobe palms thin-trunked after under two years of fertiliser; waterlogging in block 85 being drained. 19A A1/A2 suspected magnesium deficiency on sandy hardpan soil; EFB and drains started.

VEHICLES (PA Table 21, to Feb 2026): farm tractors over budget by more than 40% (e.g. Kubota SAC3874E RM26.23/hr vs 13.43) due to repairs; damaged mini crawlers to be written off.

RAINFALL (Agro): FY20/21 3,745 mm/190 days; FY21/22 3,763.5/190; FY22/23 3,432.5/188; FY23/24 2,864/179; FY24/25 4,137/203; FY25/26 4,122/203 (Main Division; Jan 2026 780 mm, Feb 870 mm); May 2026 168 mm/12 days.

IMMATURE (PA): 2024A/2025A planted, supplying needed after floods and monkeys; 23A rehabilitation, terraces done; spray remaining Lalang and bamboo grass, then Garlon and Ally; add drains; GIS stand census. PA concluding: performance improving; focus on interrow weeds, worker productivity and mechanisation; consider package harvesting contract starting with Tobe.

Delay from heavy rain Jan–Mar 2026 and too few workers; labour raised from 19 to 29 by Apr 2026, finish expected May 2026. spraying.v: Estate May 2025–Apr 2026: 2,841.10 of 4,110.24 ha programme (3 rounds), 69%, 2.1 rounds (Table 7).
Estate May 2025–Apr 2026: 2,586.68 of 4,110.24 ha programme (3 rounds), 63%, 1.9 rounds (Table 9).
PA Tables 7 and 9 also print a row '2024A 17.37 ha': circle 27.81 of 52.11 ha (53%, 1.6 rounds); selective 0 of 52.11 ha (0%) — not matched to a dashboard block.

Circle: Inter Pump, glyphosate; 4.50 ha/man-day at RM18.00/ha, RM81.00/day; separate circle work from Lalang/Giant Paspalum/roadside spraying; one round could be a mist-blower round with glyphosate 4.0-6.0 L/ha. Inter-row: mist blower, Trichlopyr (Kenlon) for tough broadleaf, Ally 20DF for soft broadleaf; 3.0 ha/man-day at RM24.00/ha, RM72.00/day, should reach 4.5 ha (Table 8, 6.1.3.4-6.1.4.8).

Inter-row delay because sprayers helped with late manuring in heavy rain Jan–Mar 2026. Circles and paths generally free of grass; some due areas covered by broadleaf. Inter-row still dominated by Clidemia hirta, Eupatorium, Hedyotis, Melastoma, Asystasia, VOP, Stenochlaena, Bracken and sedges; spray inter-row at most every 4 months, 3 rounds a year. Jungle trees poisoned with Trichlopyr, dying. Weeding RM268/ha vs budget RM231 (rates rose RM15→18/ha circle, RM21→24/ha inter-row) (6.1.3.3-6.1.4.13).

Only two of three circle and inter-row rounds done in FY2025/26 (05A and 09A did three inter-row); third round due Mar–Apr 2026 dropped as labour moved to manuring; most blocks last sprayed Dec 2025–Jan 2026; early regrowth seen; sporadic grasses and Clidemia; VOP control spraying to be prioritised in FY2026/27 (4.4.2-4.4.7).
FY2026/27 (2026–27) weeding not yet started in the Main Division at 25 May 2026; work focused on Tobe; expedite (4.4.8).

Tobe FY2025/26: only one inter-row round done; circle mostly two rounds; held back by few workers and high rain. Circles and paths clear; woody weeds and overgrown Clidemia in inter-terraces on hills (5.14-5.15).

pests.v: No serious pests or diseases except minimal rats. Rat baiting 1 round over 1,308.31 ha to Feb 2026 (STORM; 2 baits/palm Main, 1 Sg Kaindangan), programme complete; census every 3 months, bait with second-generation bait if damage exceeds 10%. Bagworm: no treatment in FY2025/26; signs of infection seen, stay vigilant. Oryctes: no treatment, no serious damage. Ganoderma: seen in tall 2004 and 2005 palms of Main Division; no census, mounding not needed. Cost RM45/ha vs budget RM35 (STORM dearer than budgeted Ebor) (6.3).
No formal rat census; field damage minimal and localised; keep monitoring (5.19).

pruning.v: Estate 749,037 palms pruned vs 650,264 programme, 115%, 4.6 rounds (May 2025–Apr 2026); overrun from corrective pruning at Sg Kaindangan. Payment every 3 months. Improve frond stacking on flat and undulating land: stack in patches within 4 palms. Cost RM255/ha, 71% over budget (Table 13, 6.4).

Main Division FY2025/26 programme nearly done; minimal under-pruning; frond snapping on steep hills, only dry fronds removed; stacking inconsistent but fronds now out of circles; FY2026/27 pruning started (4.3.2-4.3.4). Tobe programme not completed (few harvesters); canopy acceptable (5.10-5.11).

harvesting.v: 80 harvesters, 1 per 16 ha, in 3 gangs (1 Sg Kaindangan, 2 Main). Manual cutter-carrier with wheelbarrows (mini-crawler broken, write off); tractor grabber to bins; internal transport own tractors, external outsourced at RM24-27/t to Paitan mill. Feb 2026 average 2.85 rounds, 28.5 rounds in 10 months. Output 0.50-2.83 t/man-day, RM41-56/t, RM35-118/day; low from Feb rain. Harvesting & collection RM122.59/t vs budget RM105.57 (7.1-7.19).
Intervals improved vs FY2024/25; harvesting delays minimal; few unripe/overripe bunches; loose fruit acceptable but some oxidised fruit at collection platforms (4.1.1-4.1.4).
